diagram_previews.alt: A vertical green tree of height 5 sqrt 3 on level ground between west and east. A blue sun ray at 60 degrees from the east (sun at 9:00 AM) passes over the top of the tree and ends at the tip of a blue shadow of length 5 on the west side; a red dashed ray from the west (sun at 1:00 PM) gives a red shadow of length 5 on the east side.
